notablePrerequisites:
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
description:
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Treasure Vault from your graveyard, causing you to create a token of Treasure Vault.
When the Treasure Vault token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate the Treasure Vault token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Treasure Vault token and causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.
